name: Golmaal Boys Hiding Under Pots
visual_description: Four men walking in a row at an event covering their heads and faces with large metal cooking vessels and boxes to disguise themselves.
usage_context: Used to depict awkwardly trying to avoid someone, sneaking into a place uninvited, or hiding from responsibilities and embarrassing situations.

example.top_text: Me and the boys entering the wedding for free food
